notes: THE BOUND YOU ASKED ME TO CHECK, AND IT IS BROKEN. Round 1 (exec 12041445) rendered the notice AND answered with 6 files. Round 2 renders the notice and then NOTHING: 0 answers, 0 attachments, _brand_gate_closed true. Mechanism (traced in tier-gate.js): entitlement ['End User'] -> mapEntitlement().brands == [] because parseLevel('End User') returns brand null; the LLM emitted access_levels ['Sorento Office'] for the message 'office promo for SRTBF11710', D9 unions that to query_brands ['sorento']; recompose() computes brandGateEmpty = qb.length>0 && !qb.some(b => entMap.brands.includes(b)) which is unconditionally TRUE for a brandless entitlement; the Q23 widen branch is then skipped (it is guarded on !brand_gate_empty) and D10 in promo-picker deletes answers+attachments. Contradicts plan §3 ('End User -> {brand: null (all entitled brands)}'). The rendered reply is also incoherent (§68 class): "...here's what you do have:" followed by nothing but an escalation offer. Bounded by F1-b (see rollup): with a BRANDED entitlement ['Sorento Dealer','End User'] the same unheld-tier query answers correctly with the notice + 6 files, so the defect is specifically the brandless End-User-only contact — which is exactly plan journey rows 4 and 6.
